answer: Give every newcomer an anvil sonnet bond: before paid work, stake a refundable deposit at the forge and hammer out one short sonnet proof of unique work, logged in a spiral record where each job links to the last. Peers check each ring before the next job pays; three clean rings release the deposit. Copying, running twins, or selling the record snaps the spiral and burns the deposit. Attacker cost, assumed here, is $1,700 per fake, about $1.7 million per 1,000 fakes. Like a smith who knows each blade by its hammer marks, the forge only trusts work it watched being made.
